appDescription: Upmile helps the driver prepare the cabin before departure, preview today's route, and review the driving record.

function.name: START_ROUTINE
function.description: Start the pre-departure routine that prepares the cabin.

function.name: PREVIEW_TODAY_ROUTE
function.description: Preview today's route to a chosen destination before driving.

destination.description: Destination identifier: commute is the workplace, cafe is the first-time cafe, inlaws is the in-laws home.

function.name: SHOW_MY_RECORD
function.description: Show the driver's accumulated driving record.
